factual_errors: Art. 4 BV establishes national languages, not official languages; response misquotes it and claims Romansh is one of four official languages on equal terms.
Response omits ~40,000 main-language speakers / 0.5% BFS figure, instead citing 59,726 speakers at 0.8% for census 2000, conflicting with key facts.
summary: Italian response hedges speaker counts plausibly but misstates Romansh's constitutional status by misquoting Art. 4 (national, not official, languages) and omitting the 0.5% main-language figure.
